scope: Verifier-only hotfix for Passing Yards Projection Explainability Step 2. The first merged public proof found the selected-QB detail and Jordan Love, then failed because it required the frozen V70 runtime marker to be inside that same detail frame. The acceptance contract only requires V70 and V222 runtime markers to exist in the hosted app. This hotfix searches all Streamlit frames for each runtime marker while preserving every product assertion.

first_broken_arrow: selected-QB detail + Jordan Love -> same-frame V70 marker ownership assertion
root_cause: The public verifier coupled the V70 runtime marker to the selected-detail frame. Runtime markers and selected detail are independent rendered surfaces; marker presence must be verified across the hosted Streamlit frame set, matching the existing global V222 lookup pattern.
patch: Use the existing cross-frame find() helper for V70 and V222 marker presence. Keep the selected-QB root, V71 ready marker, five drivers, explainability fields, content, and no-overflow assertions unchanged.
